fields.description: Naya Residences is Nakheel’s lagoon-side residential collection in District One. The currently linked collection comprises Naya 4, 5 and 6, with one- to four-bedroom apartments, a five-bedroom penthouse and three-bedroom lagoon villas. Tiered balconies and shared gardens connect the homes to the setting, while distinct layouts serve different household needs.
amenities: Infinity pool and shaded children’s pool
Fitness centre and outdoor fitness spaces
Indoor and outdoor children's play areas

research.community: Naya 4, Naya 5 and Naya 6 · District One
overview: The current brochure and drawings identify this as a new phase. Earlier Naya releases may have different unit mixes, payment plans and delivery dates; they are not used to overwrite these Naya 4–6 documents.

The penthouse drawing spans two levels and separates suite area from balcony area. Lagoon villa totals likewise include substantial outdoor area. Compare the unit’s suite area as well as the headline total before deciding how much enclosed space it offers.
research.locationNote: District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City, Dubai. No exact MBR City entry currently exists in the local area taxonomy; areaId remains null. Developer travel-time illustrations are not live routing estimates.
research.priceLabel: Published starting price · original sheet; reconfirm
research.priceNote: The developer-linked sheet lists starting guides of AED 1.8m (1BR), 2.7m (2BR), 3.2m (2BR + maid), 4.5m (3BR), 7.6m (4BR) and 8.9m (lagoon villas). No penthouse price is printed. Its instalments begin in 2025; these are published guides, not verified current allocations.
research.paymentNote: The linked sheet totals 100%: 20% booking, 45% dated interim instalments and 35% in December 2028. The full original dates appear below. Past instalments are not a new-booking offer.
research.handoverNote: The developer-linked sheet estimates December 2028 completion. The separate progress webpage names no tower numbers; its percentage is not assigned to Naya 4–6 or used to change this estimate.
